override_reason: Automated NPL rule incorrectly classified this as a DPL. Project financed rehabilitation of 420 km of primary and secondary roads, maintenance equipment, training, technical assistance, and improvements to road administration. Fully disbursed $30M; $0 cancelled. This is conventional investment lending unambiguously tied to physical infrastructure output.

Export Development Loan (1983) was a SAL-era companion adjustment operation, part of the same policy-reform package as SAL I. Retained as DPL on analytical grounds: the operation supported export-sector liberalisation and institutional reforms, not identifiable investment activities. The automated name-match rules do not catch this project; the override makes the decision explicit and auditable.
evidence_source: Classified in consultation with SAL-era context. See World Bank Costa Rica country assistance evaluation: https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/703151468749950643/pdf/Costa-Rica-Country-assistance-evaluation.pdf
